description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of stimulus types used in a study, with a total of eight categories represented. The slices are labeled “Stimulus Type” and include “Social Media Post” (1.1%, red), “Press Release” (18.7%, dark red), “Email” (2.7%, green), “Event Posting” (6.6%, purple), “Organizational Report” (7.7%, blue), “Organizational Website” (4.9%, dark blue), “Intra-agency news article” (4.9%, teal), and “External News Article” (18.1%, gray). “Interview” is also represented (8.8%, magenta). Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice, and a legend is not present. The slices appear to be arranged in a clockwise order, with the largest segments positioned first and decreasing in size as they proceed around the circle.
